notes.title: 2 new DLCs available! 10% off with launch discount (until Oct. 7, 10 AM PDT)
notes.notes: [h3]We released three new DLC packs today, September 23, 2025.[/h3][p]Introducing the high-resolution pixel art character set “Vibrato HERO PIXEL PACK Vol.2” featuring an Elf and a Fighter, and the “PixelScapes Modern Suburban Pack” 3D model pack that recreates a modern suburban town.[/p][p]Also, 10% off launch discount until October 7, 2025 at 10am PDT! Don't miss this opportunity![/p][p][/p][h3]Overview of DLC Released on September 23, 2025.[/h3][p][b]RPG Developer Bakin Vibrato HERO PIXEL PACK Vol.2[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4007350/"][/dynamiclink]This DLC is a collection of high-resolution pixel art character assets, newly created by pixel art artist Vibrato, based on the four characters included in RPG Developer Bakin's standard assets: "Warrior A", "Warrior B", "Elf A", and "Elf B". [/p][p]Compared to the 40 x 40 pixels per frame of the standard assets, this collection is produced at about four times the resolution. The details and personalities of each character are expressed more finely and attractively.  [/p][p]It also includes 14 exclusive actions and poses that match the characteristics of each character. This enables dynamic movement and rich emotional expression, and greatly expands the range of in-game production. [/p][p][/p][p][b]RPG Developer Bakin PixelScapes Modern Suburban Pack[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4007360/"][/dynamiclink]PixelScapes Modern Suburban Pack is a pixel-art style 3D model set for recreating cozy, modern suburban neighborhoods. It includes a wide variety of friendly and inviting suburban elements such as houses, shops, playgrounds (with swings and slides), and school buses—perfect for games set in modern-day life, mysteries, school settings, and more. [/p]

notes.title: Official Release of “RPG Developer Bakin”!
notes.notes:
[h2]“RPG Developer Bakin” Officially Launches After Extensive Evolution[/h2][p]Since its Early Access debut in October 2022, “RPG Developer Bakin” has undergone continuous development driven by user feedback, leading to numerous feature additions and refinements. [/p][p]Today marks a major turning point with the implementation of a large-scale update focused on expanding customization and strategic options—such as equipment slot expansion and level-based item unlocks—ushering in the official launch of the full version. [/p][p]This release is more than just an update; it signifies the beginning of Bakin as a full-featured tool that empowers anyone to easily create professional-quality RPGs. [/p][p]Alongside the official launch, a free trial version is now available, allowing users to experience the tool’s capabilities firsthand. Furthermore, a sample game created with Bakin has been updated with multilingual support through today’s release of the plugin DLC “Localization Toolkit”. [/p][p]We remain committed to improving Bakin and adding new features so that creators can continue to enjoy game development to the fullest.[/p][p][/p][h3]RPG Developer Bakin Trailer Ver. 3: [/h3][previewyoutube="2VrAknHx6fA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]  [/p][h3]RPG Developer Bakin Official Release Overview[/h3][list][*][p]Title: RPG Developer Bakin[/p][/*][*][p]Genre: Game Creation Tool[/p][/*][*][p]Recommended System Requirements:[/p][p]OS: Windows10 (64bit), CPU: Core i5-8400/Ryzen 5 1500X or better, Memory: 16GB, Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce™ GTX1650/AMD Radeon™ RX570, Storage: 8 GB available space[/p][/*][*][p]Supported Languages: Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional)[/p][/*][*][p]Release Date: August 28, 2025.[/p][/*][*][p]Price: [b]$84.99 USD[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Note:[/p][p]- If you have purchased the Early Access version, it will be updated to the official release at no additional cost.
- Any DLC you have already purchased or are currently using will remain available after the official release.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]RPG Developer Bakin Trial Version Overview[/h3][list][*][p]Name: RPG Developer Bakin Demo[/p][/*][*][p]Release Date: August 28, 2025[/p][/*][*][p]Price: Free[/p][/*][*][p]Note:[/p][p]- Please note that some features are restricted.
- Game data created in the trial version can be transferred to the full version.
- Further details will be announced later via Steam News and other sources.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Sample Games “Orb Stories” and “Dungeon RPG Sample” – Update Overview[/h3][p]Two sample games created with Bakin—“Orb Stories” and “Dungeon RPG Sample”—have been updated with multilingual support using the newly released plugin DLC “Localization Toolkit”, available starting today. [/p][p]Previously managed as separate game data for English and Japanese versions, the games are now unified into a single dataset that allows users to seamlessly switch between multiple languages. [/p][p]The “Localization Toolkit” plugin enables not only the translation of in-game text (dialogue, UI, etc.) but also supports switching in-game assets such as signs and UI images. Language switching can be done with a single click from the in-game menu, providing a fully localized experience. notes.title: Official Release! More Equipment Slots, Item Unlock Levels – Update Ver. 2.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone! 
Thanks to your incredible support, we’re excited to announce the release of Version 2.0 – the Official Release of RPG Developer Bakin!
[/h3][p]Since the launch of Early Access in October 2022, your warm encouragement and constructive feedback have guided us every step of the way.[/p][p]The entire development team would like to express our heartfelt gratitude. [/p][p]We’ll continue to work hard to improve Bakin, so that it remains a fun and powerful tool for creating games.[/p][p]Thank you so much for your continued support!  [/p][hr][/hr][p]In this update, we’ve introduced a number of exciting new features. [/p][p]You can now enable "dual wielding", allowing characters to equip weapons in both hands.[/p][p]We’ve also added item unlock level settings, letting you specify what level is required before an item can be used. [/p][p]In the layout tool, scrollbars can now be applied to menus, and variables can be used as parameters for special formats—giving you even more freedom when designing UI screens.[/p][p]And we're also releasing Localization Toolkit, a paid DLC that enables text and resource localization so you can switch languages from a single build. [/p][p]This DLC isn’t just for localization—it’s also a powerful tool for editing in-game text. Be sure to check it out![/p][p]Now, let’s take a closer look at the new features introduced in this update! [/p][hr][/hr][h2]New & Improved Features in Ver. 2.0[/h2][h3]
■ Add/Remove Equipment Slots[/h3][p]You can now freely add or remove equipment slots. [/p][p]Characters can equip up to two weapons (one can be shared with a shield), head and body armor, and now a new leg slot.[/p][p]Accessories can be equipped without limit. [/p][p]This means dual wielding is now possible—plus, yes, you can equip 10 rings at once if you like![/p][p] [/p][h3]■ Item Unlock Level Settings[/h3][p]The “Usable Items” section for characters and classes has been revamped to allow item restrictions and unlock levels. [/p][p]You can now create items like:[/p][p]-A holy sword that becomes equippable at level 10[/p][p]-A spellbook that only becomes usable when a class reaches level 20[/p][p] [/p][h3]■ Scrollbars in Menu Containers[/h3][p]You can now add scrollbars to menu containers.[/p][p]This makes it easier to display long lists—such as many items or skills—using a scrollable view instead of switching between pages.[/p][p] [/p][h3]■ Use Variables in Special Formats[/h3][p]You can now specify variables or array variables as parameters in special formats.[/p][p]For example, you can write: \\partyclasslevel\[\\$\[VariableName]]. [/p][p]This makes dynamic text display even more flexible and powerful.[/p][p] [/p][h3]■ Improved 3D Resource Import/Delete Dialog[/h3][p]When importing or deleting 3D resources, you can now view a list of the assets included and select which ones to import or remove individually.[/p][p] [/p][h3]■ Tag List for Easy Tag Management[/h3][p]When adding tags, you can now choose from a list of existing tags.[/p][p]Descriptions can also be added to each tag, making it easier to organize and reuse them.[/p][p] [/p][h3]■ Debug Window Improvements[/h3][p]We’ve added a new "Variable Monitor" tab to the debug window, which displays variables used in the current scene in a tree structure.[/p][p]We’ve also added a filter to the "Event Monitor" for easier navigation.[/p][p] [/p][h3]■ Dark Theme[/h3][p]A dark theme is now available for the tool UI![/p][p]Enjoy a more comfortable look for extended development sessions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/b9117420aabd7dd12f2be17a610d28a91c1f90b2.png"][/img][/p][h3]■ Localization Toolkit (Paid DLC)[/h3][p]We're also releasing a paid DLC that adds a powerful localization tool plugin. [/p][p]This allows you to localize not only in-game text but also graphics, sound resources, and more by language—all from a single build. [/p][p]Edits made using this tool are directly reflected in the project data, making it incredibly useful not only for localization but also for efficient text editing during game development.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3920860/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]For details on other update contents, please check the online manual or go to "[url="https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Update+log"]Update Log[/url]" in the "Info & Tips" section of Bakin's Top Menu. [/p][hr][/hr][p]
[b]We hope this update helps you create even more amazing games.[/b][/p][p][b]Take advantage of the new features and bring your world to life![/b]
[/p]

notes.title: Bug Fix Notice: “SMILE Characters DX Vol.1”
notes.notes:
[h3]To Users of “SMILE Characters DX Vol.1” [/h3]

We would like to inform you that several adjustments and fixes have been made to some of the character data included in the paid DLC “SMILE Characters DX Vol.1”.

[h3]- Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Skin Weight Corrections[/b]
We have corrected an issue affecting all characters where the lower legs (calves) were incorrectly influenced by the toe bones instead of the appropriate leg bones. This caused unnatural deformations when bending the knees.
Additionally, for characters with long hair, we have fixed an issue where the tips of the hair were not weighted to the head bone, leading to unnatural movement, such as when turning the head.
[*] [b]Motion Data Standardization[/b]
Motion data has been standardized to match that of “SMILE Characters DX Vol.2”.
Along with this update, motion names have also been changed to follow the naming conventions used in Vol.2.
[/list]
[h3]- Important Notice[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you are already using the old version of the data in your project, importing the updated version with the "overwrite" option may result in motions not playing correctly.
This is due to changes in motion names, which can break the link between the model and its animations.
[*] To avoid this issue, please make sure to use the "Add with a different ID" option when importing the updated version. This will register the updated character data as a separate resource.
[/list]

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused, and thank you for your continued support.

[b]RPG Developer Bakin Ultra Building Victorian Style[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3792090/
This DLC lets you recreate a classic Victorian-style world, featuring grand mansions, towns with smoke rising from chimneys, and plazas adorned with cobblestone paths and fountains. It includes modular parts such as building walls and windows, decorative objects like benches, fences, fountains, and streetlights, as well as ready-to-use prefab buildings and sample town maps.

[b]RPG Developer Bakin Mokemo Factory MONSTER PIXEL PACK Vol.5[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3853520/
The fifth volume of the monster battler asset series by pixel artist Mokemo is here! This collection features 20 uniquely designed monsters, each with its own backstory—from a space traveler riding a haniwa-style camel, to a centipede warrior consumed by the madness of the battlefield, to a scorching predator that hunts with searing claws. These distinctive creatures will bring striking presence and rich depth to the world of your game, making your story more vivid and unforgettable.


[b]RPG Developer Bakin Vibrato NPC PIXEL PACK Vol.2[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3853510/
This DLC is a high-resolution pixel art character asset pack featuring ten support characters—"Royal A," "Royal B," "Royal C," "Royal D," "Cabinet Minister," "Housekeeper," "Butler," "Clergyperson A," "Clergyperson B," and "Merchant"—originally included in the standard assets of RPG Developer Bakin. Pixel artist Vibrato has redrawn each character from scratch, enhancing them with intricate details and expressive charm. While the original assets were created at 40×40 pixels per frame, this new set offers approximately four times the resolution. The pack includes two types of animations per character: Walk and Wait. These lively characters will add depth and vibrancy to the towns and scenes within your game world.

notes.title: Enhanced "Selection" Panel & 3D Sound! Update Ver.1.15 Released!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone! 
We have released Ver. 1.15 today!
[/h3]

This update introduces a variety of new features to make game creation deeper and more flexible than ever!
These additions are designed to help you craft richer stories and more immersive worlds.

Now, let’s look at the main new features!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Main Features Added and Improved in Ver. 1.15[/h2]

[h3]- Enhanced Selection Panel[/h3]
We've added several highly requested features, including branching based on cancel button input and the ability to use variables as display conditions.

These improvements allow you to tailor choices more precisely to each scene, making it easier to create more complex and immersive story developments.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/9ab7adc3fdec470e11980212e9b10413efe04608.jpg[/img]

[h3]- Variable Support for Layout Part Display Conditions [/h3]
You can now specify variables as display conditions for submenu containers and render containers.

By combining multiple variables, you can flexibly control your UI, for example, showing elements only when specific conditions are met.

This gives you the freedom to design a more refined and dynamic user interface, limited only by your creativity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/d679abc71dc24b4098d89c15dbf0d4bdd4dedd15.jpg[/img]

[h3]- Simplified 3D Sound Mode[/h3]
Bakin features a 3D sound engine capable of reproducing binaural audio through regular speakers.
This engine simulates how humans perceive sound with both ears, allowing for realistic depth and directionality—ideal for immersive audio experiences like ASMR.

In this update, we've added a simplified mode that applies positional information only through basic left-right speaker panning.

You can also configure attenuation methods and set custom start and end distances, giving you greater control and flexibility in sound design.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/3bfd97008b791a8455832412d9e3020513804afe.jpg[/img]
[h3]- Variable List[/h3]
The "Variable Used" feature has been upgraded into a full-fledged Variable List dialog.

Now, you can select a variable from the list to instantly see where it's being used—reversing the previous workflow.

In addition, you can now add or delete variables directly within this dialog, making variable management significantly more efficient.
  
[h3]- Party Train Spacing[/h3]
We've added a new feature that allows you to adjust the spacing between cast members when moving in the party train—something that was previously fixed.


For details on other update contents, please check the online manual or go to "[url=https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Update+log]Update Log[/url]" in the "Info & Tips" section of Bakin's Top Menu.

[hr][/hr]

[b]We are pleased to announce that Bakin will release its official release on August 28.

As we move toward the official release—and beyond—we will continue to add new features and make ongoing improvements.

Our team is committed to evolving this tool so you can fully enjoy creating games that bring your imagined worlds, original characters, and carefully crafted systems to life.

Thank you for your continued support!

We hope this update helps you create even more amazing games.
Make the most of the new features and turn your world into a game!
[/b]

notes.title: 3 new DLCs available! 10% off with launch discount (until July. 10, 10 AM PDT)
notes.notes:
[h3]We released three new DLC packs today, June 26, 2025.[/h3]
Here’s a quick overview of the three newly revealed DLCs: "Mokemo Factory MONSTER PIXEL PACK Vol.4", a pixel art asset pack featuring a variety of unique battle monsters; "Classic RPG Music Pack", a BGM collection that recreates the nostalgic atmosphere of classic RPGs; and "House Builder Pack Asian Style", a 3D model pack that lets you freely build medieval Asian-style houses.
Also, 10% off launch discount until July 10, 2025 at 10am PDT! Don't miss this opportunity!


[h3]Overview of DLC Released on June 26, 2025[/h3]

[b]RPG Developer Bakin Mokemo Factory MONSTER PIXEL PACK Vol.4[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3748420/
The fourth installment in the battle monster sprite series by pixel artist Mokemo. This collection features 20 uniquely designed monsters, each with its own intriguing backstory—from otherworldly abominations and emotion-infused fruits, to thunder-dancing birds and love-cursed shadows. Whether as formidable foes to challenge the player or mysterious beings that guide the story, these distinctive pixel art monsters will bring greater depth and vivid color to your game world. Let your imagination run wild and enhance your game's atmosphere with these captivating characters.


[b]RPG Developer Bakin Classic RPG Music Pack[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3792100/
This is a collection of BGM tracks that recreate the atmosphere of the 16-bit and early 32-bit RPG era, evoking nostalgia for classic role-playing games.
From the melancholic theme of a quiet village, ominous dungeon tunes, and environmental music for snowy fields and volcanoes, to intense boss battle tracks — this pack includes a wide range of sounds to accompany your game from its beginning, through climactic moments, all the way to the ending.
With memorable melodies and nostalgic tones, these tracks provide a deep sense of immersion and emotion, enhancing the atmosphere of your game world.
While especially well-suited for RPGs, this music pack is also ideal for adventure, simulation, and many other genres. Highly recommended for creators looking to infuse their projects with the spirit of "those days."


[b]RPG Developer Bakin House Builder Pack Asian Style[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3792080/
This product is a modular 3D resource pack that allows you to freely combine parts to create a wide variety of medieval Asian-style houses.
The included parts are finely categorized—walls, floors, roofs, pillars, windows, doors, and more—giving you the flexibility to build anything from simple homes to large residences and two-story buildings by utilizing the "subgraphic" feature.
Additionally, the pack includes prefabricated structures made by combining multiple parts, enabling you to easily start building houses using them as a base.

notes.title: Showcasing User-Made Plugins & Now Calling for Plugin Submissions!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello everyone! [/b][/h3]
 
Thank you for enjoying creating games with “RPG Developer Bakin”. 
 
Even without programming knowledge, anyone can create games using "RPG Developer Bakin". However, by utilizing C# plugins, you can unlock a much wider range of features and effects.
We, the development team, are truly grateful to the many creators around the world who continue to develop and share amazing plugins.
At the same time, we’ve felt that the lack of a centralized place to view plugin information may be preventing these valuable resources from reaching those who need them most.
 
To address this, [b]we’ve added a new "Plugin Information List" to the official website.[/b]
This list features plugin information submitted by creators through a dedicated form, and we will publish the content in Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
 
We hope this initiative helps more people discover and share the C# plugins you’ve created.
We would greatly appreciate your support in registering your plugin information!
 
Also, if you're interested in exploring what C# plugins can do, we encourage you to check out the list. While it’s still in the early stages and doesn’t have many entries yet, we hope it becomes a helpful resource for your game development journey.

This is a minor update for bug fixes and adjustments, but we are publishing this news because of some important points.
Please see [url=https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Update+log]the update log[/url] for details on the update.
[hr][/hr]
[h3]- Fixed a bug in the "Execute Common Event" panel since ver. 1.13.2.[/h3]
This may change the behavior of the "Execute Common Event" panel, which was [b]added after ver. 1.13.2. [/b]

The behavior up to Ver. 1.14.1 was specifically as follows:

- "Wait to Complete" is also applied to "Wait until the Event is Executable".
- "Wait until the Event is Executable" is interpreted as "Start Execution from Next Frame"
- The check status of "Start Execution from Next Frame" is not affected by the execution of events.

Now these will work as described in each option.

[h3]- The default value of "CCD Radius Coefficient" was changed to "1".[/h3]
[b]Projects that were edited after ver. 1.14.1[/b] are left with the previous default value of "2", so please adjust accordingly.

CCD (Continuous Collision Detection) was introduced to prevent the player from passing through mesh colliders when moving at high speed. 

The "CCD Radius Coefficient" acts as a multiplier for the player's collision detection. Increasing this value can help reduce instances of passing through objects. However, it may also cause side effects, such as making the player bounce off edges more easily when jumping near ledges or steps. 

However, considering the effect on behavior when jumping while approaching a step, we have changed the setting this time.

[b](!) [/b]If you do not need this feature, you can set the value to "0" to disable CCD and revert to the same behavior as in versions prior to 1.14.

[h3]- Fixed a bug where newly generated events were incorrectly treated as hits when using the "Change Player/Event Scale" panel, starting from version 1.14.1. [/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Thank you very much for your understanding and cooperation.

We will continue to improve "RPG Developer Bakin".

notes.title: Enhance Your Game's Visuals! Update Ver. 1.14 Adds Support for Multiple Fonts
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone! 
We have updated to Ver. 1.14! [/h3]

This update introduces a range of new features designed to significantly enhance both the quality of your game and the comfort of your development experience, starting with the highly requested support for multiple fonts in-game.
 
We’ve also made the editor’s text data publicly accessible, allowing users to localize the editor themselves—an important step toward broader language support.
 
Now, let’s take a look at the new features!
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Main Features Added and Improved in Ver. 1.14[/h2]

[h3]Significantly Enhanced Visual Expression: Multiple Font Support In-Game [/h3]
Ever wanted to use different fonts for dialogue text and UI elements, or change the tone of just part of a message? Now you can!

By choosing fonts that perfectly match each scene, your game’s visual presentation can become more compelling than you ever imagined.
 
You can import and use your own fonts in .ttf or .otf format. We encourage you to take full advantage of this feature!
(Please be sure to check the license terms of any fonts you use.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/09ea24544fa2805db64794ee561c56e604254ff5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/caa6301c5f6703db1ef930f5be11c28b267d89c3.png[/img]

[h3]Localization Mod Support [/h3]
We have released a Language Pack containing the necessary files to localize the Bakin editor.
By translating the provided files and placing them in a designated folder, users can localize the tool itself into their preferred language.
(Please note that the distribution of localization files is subject to the RPG Developer Bakin End User License Agreement (EULA).)

[h3]Even Greater Possibilities with C#: Bind Multiple C# Scripts to a Single Event[/h3]
It is now possible to bind multiple C# scripts to a single event, making it easier to build more complex processes and improve script reusability.
Additionally, the method selection dialog used during binding has been redesigned for better usability.

Movement speeds for players and events can now be finely adjusted as a percentage relative to a base speed, enabling more precise and flexible scene direction.
We have also improved the responsiveness of the debug window during test play, resulting in a smoother development experience overall.

In addition to these, Version 1.14 includes numerous other feature additions and improvements.

For details on other update contents, please check the online manual or go to "[url=https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Update+log]Update Log[/url]" in the "Info & Tips" section of Bakin's Top Menu.

notes.title: Update Ver. 1.13.2 released!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone!
We have updated to Ver. 1.13.2![/h3]

This update may not be "cool", but it includes new features and improvements that will contribute to the production and quality of your work! 

See the main features.
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Internal Engine Optimization[/h3]
We have further optimized the internal engine.
This will improve the performance speed of games created with Bakin. 

The issue of slow processing when NVIDIA Control Panel > “Thread Optimization” was turned on has also been improved.

[b]If you have already released your work, please try the Published Work Export again to apply this update to your game![/b]

In addition, the online manual contains information on how to read the Performance Meter and what to do if you feel your game is running too slow. Please refer to it as you update your work.

[h3]Cast and Class “Characteristics”[/h3]
It is now possible to set so-called passive skills for cast members and classes.

This allows for the creation of more distinctive characters and classes, such as the "brave knight who is always a target" or the "lucky merchant with consistently high battle rewards." It brings depth and strategic elements to the story, enhancing the player's immersion.

[h3]Subgraphic "Use as Item Hook"[/h3]
This feature makes it easier for VRM models to carry weapons and armor when they enter battles! If you are using VRM models, we encourage you to try them out!

[h3]Specify the Timing for Calling Common Events[/h3]
Added the function to the "Execute Common Event" panel to check the status of the target common event to be called and specify when to call and execute the event.

For example, the initialization process at map entry, which used to take more than two frames when separated into common events, can now be combined into a single frame.

[h3]Obtaining the "Intersection" of the Raycast and the Target[/h3]
The "Check Surrounding Collision Detection" panel now can obtain the coordinates of the “intersection” of the raycast and the check target in a specified variable.

For example, detecting how far ahead a wall is can be handled by simply producing one long raycast. This can simplify a complex decision process.

[h3]Improved Event Sheet Listing[/h3]

The relationship between the order of the sheet list and the order of processing has been clarified and improved to make it easier for beginners to understand.

The normal event sheets are now executed "from the top of the list".

(For those of you who have been using the software for a long time, it may take some time to get used to its operation. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.)

Please see the [url=https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Update+log]online manual[/url] for more details on this feature and other additions, improvements, and bug fixes.
[hr][/hr]
We hope that these added features will be useful for your game creation!

Try out the new features and let your ideas take shape!

We will continue to improve "RPG Developer Bakin".

notes.title: Update Ver. 1.13.1 released!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone!
We have updated to Ver. 1.13.1![/h3]

We have made it easier to manipulate variables and to set the attack attributes granting ability of items in more detail. This update is an assortment of several feature additions and bug fixes to aid your creation.

Discover the main features.
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Addition of "Manipulate Array Variable" and "Batch Clear Variables" panels[/h3]
It is now possible to change the elements of array variables all at once, clear specified variables all at once, and so on. This allows the processing that was previously done using a loop to be done all at once.

[h3]Added "Obtain Bone Coordinates" panel and added offset values for "Check Surrounding Collision Detection", "Generate Events" and "Display Effect"[/h3]
Now it is possible to emit a beam from the eyes of a 3D model and obtain the location where the beam hits.

[h3]Added "Do Nothing" to the battle command system tag[/h3]
By granting a "state" to an enemy that disables the "Do Nothing" command, it is now possible to make an enemy that has done nothing suddenly become active.

[h3]Added “State Granting” ability to item's abilities[/h3]
We can now create weapons with more detailed settings, such as "a weapon that grants 'paralysis' to the opponent while dealing damage with the dark attribute".

[h3]During battles, the visual appearances of enemies show the enemy's equipment[/h3]
Models attached to item hooks, such as "Orc with club," are now displayed during battles.

[h3]Enhanced post effect “SSAO” functionality[/h3]
By modifying the algorithm and adding parameters, the shadows of objects can be more accurately rendered.


Please see the [url=https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Update+log]online manual[/url] for more details on this feature and other additions, improvements, and bug fixes.
[hr][/hr]
We hope these new features will be useful to you in your game creation!
We will continue to improve “RPG Developer Bakin”.

notes.title: Enhanced Battle Features & VRM Support! Update Ver.1.13
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone!
We have updated to Ver. 1.13![/h3]

The last major update of the year will allow you to create even more heated battles!
Combine the new features we've added to the database and events, such as skill reflection, enhanced critical hits, and more, to create even more unique battles.
In addition, you can now import models directly into Bakin in the VRM format, which is strong for 3D avatars!

[previewyoutube=bCHJoaMecKs;full][/previewyoutube]

Let's start with the main features!
[hr][/hr]
[h2]---- Main Features of Ver. 1.13 ----[/h2]

[h3]Enhanced Battle Related Features[/h3]
Bounce back enemy spells, equip a flaming sword and use fire magic, or take a more spectacular critical hit...
We have added various features, mainly for the Database and battle events, to make the battle system more powerful. 
  
　　- Item ability to increase the skills that can be used when equipped, or to grant a specific “state”.
　　- Register critical hit effect and change critical damage ratio
　　- "Reflection Rate" effect, which can reflect skills 
　　- Add information that can be obtained during battle using battle events
　　- Interrupt the "order of action" using battle events
　　- Feature to specify “State Granting” ability using “Tags”
　　- Enhanced damage calculation formula setting dialog
  　etc… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/9e59aefd999cf53337074c7fa3454655f91aeff5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/35241b4301b0f5f11d2bcfd2e286a57ec840997e.png[/img]

We hope you will use these new features to create a more enjoyable battle system!

[h3]Direct Import of VRM Format Models[/h3]
Models in VRM format, which is strong for 3D avatars, can now be imported directly into Bakin. 
Materials and motions pre-installed in Bakin will be assigned when such models are imported. This makes it easier to use VRM models as character models for game creation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/9fd166b48ed1097231292fd4a70b085fe34f3aed.png[/img]


For details on other update contents, please check the online manual or go to "[url=https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Update+log]Update Log[/url]" in the "Info & Tips" section of Bakin's Top Menu.
[hr][/hr]
[b]We hope you like it! 
More battle-related updates will be coming! 
Hopefully, this update will contribute to your battle scene and game creation.  
  
We will continue to improve "RPG Developer Bakin" so that users can enjoy creating games with Bakin even more. 
 
Thank you for your continued support.[/b]

notes.title: Update Ver. 1.12.1 with Load Time & Game Size Reduction Feature
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
[h3]We have updated to Ver. 1.12.1![/h3]

The main addition this time is the “Convert to Internal Format (beta)” feature, which reduces game load times and game size.

This is the ability to pre-convert models and textures to a Bakin-optimized format. (The original resources are retained while the converted resources are newly added.)

This feature has the following advantages and disadvantages:

[Advantages]
[list]
[*]Speeds up the loading process during games.
[*]The memory used by the game is reduced.
[*]When exporting as a published work, game size is reduced by exporting only files that have been converted to the internal format.
[/list]
[Disadvantages]
[list]
[*]Depending on your environment and the number of resources to be converted, the conversion may take a considerable amount of time.
[*]The size of the project folder will increase as it will now contain files converted to internal format.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/1023ecf12521f26470572710ef99656c71238c5c.png[/img]

Since this feature is being released as a beta version, we recommend that you check the “Backup the Entire Game File” checkbox in the dialog that appears when you turn on the feature and save the project data as an alias.

Please see the [url=https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Update+log]online manual[/url] for more details on this feature and other additions, improvements, and bug fixes.
[hr][/hr]
We hope this update will help you to create a great game.
We will continue to improve “RPG Developer Bakin”.

notes.title: Early Access Second Anniversary! Major Update Ver. 1.12
notes.notes:
[h3]Thanks to your support, we are celebrating our second anniversary! Major update Ver. 1.12 is released to add backlog feature and more.[/h3]

Hello everyone!
Many thanks to all of you, "RPG Developer Bakin" is celebrating two years since the Early Access version of the tool was launched on October 18, 2022!

We are grateful for your support, which helped us develop Bakin over the years. The entire development team would like to express our sincere gratitude!

To commemorate this second anniversary, we have released a major update Ver. 1.12, which adds a backlog feature, event skipping and other features.

Check out the main features first!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]RPG Developer Bakin Ver. 1.12 Update Overview[/h2]

[b]- Backlog Function[/b]
It is now possible to create a backlog of conversations and message text displayed during the game that can be recorded and reviewed later.

In addition, the text can be set to be included only in the backlog, or conversely, the text can be set not to be included.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/08d360efc77116918b158402c71b22c72357b4cf.png[/img]

[b]- Change Game Speed / Skip Events[/b]
Added the function to speed up/slow down the game progression, as well as a mechanism to skip events by taking advantage of it.
It is possible to skip events by speeding up the game triggered by an event switch or button input.

[b]- Message Skipping[/b]
By pressing the Decide/Cancel button in conversation scenes, etc., the displayed text can now be displayed all at once up to the page feed.

[b]- Movie Playback During Battles[/b]
Movies can now be called up during battles.
This allows the use of movies to visualize scenes of character interaction and skill activation during battles.

Many other features have been added and improved. 
Please take this opportunity to challenge yourself to create a game with “RPG Developer Bakin”.

For details of the major update Ver. 1.12, please click here for the news.

For details on other update contents, please check the online manual or go to "[url=https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Update+log]Update Log[/url]" in the "Info & Tips" section of Bakin's Top Menu.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Updated Roadmap of Upcoming Features to be Implemented! & Extension Announcement of Early Access Period![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/d4c3bacedae892ec7302153833c1ad2a00243d30.png[/img]

We have updated the roadmap for features to be implemented in the future. In addition to these features, there are many other features currently under consideration, and we will continue to update the roadmap as needed. 

In addition, based on user feedback and requests, we will change the Early Access period to "during 2025" to further develop and improve the features and capabilities of the tool.

*The latest roadmap is available on the official website.
[url=https://rpgbakin.com/roadmap]Click here for the “Road Map” page [/url]on the official website

[hr][/hr]
[h2]2nd Anniversary Sale[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/70955fd00c594f0e7d0885ade9935cfefe007c95.png[/img]

To celebrate the second anniversary of the Early Access version of the tool, we are holding a sale.
Bakin and eligible DLCs will be discounted by 10%, and bundled editions including eligible products will be even more affordable.
For more information, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1036640/view/4553793657361726347]click here.[/url]

[hr][/hr]
[b]Our development team is always encouraged by the wonderful creations published daily on social networks, Steam and other distribution sites.

We will continue to improve our tool for our users and new Bakin users so that they can enjoy making games with Bakin even more.[/b]

notes.title: Auto save, “state” abilities added, and more! Update Ver. 1.11!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone!
We have updated to Ver. 1.11![/h3]

[b]This time we have implemented the highly requested auto save feature!
We also added "state" abilities and a "Favorites" feature that allows you to organize event panels in one place![/b]

Check out the main features first!
[hr][/hr]
[h2]---- Main Features of Ver. 1.11 ----[/h2]

[b]- Auto save function & force save/load from event[/b]
When the auto save function is turned on, the game will be saved to a special auto save slot when moving from one map to another.

It is also possible to save to the auto save slot from the event panel for added save/load, so if you combine the functions well, you will be able to execute auto save at any time you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/5eb688ec3fe6da3256521b07954a527e219eb652.png[/img]

[b]- Added User-defined Icon feature that allows images to be included in conversations and other text
[/b]Images registered in System Resources can now be displayed in texts.

Please use it to explain game UI icons, hint messages during the game, etc.

[b]- Added “Change in Resistance” and more as new “State” abilities.[/b]
In addition to the above, several other abilities have been added, such as the ability to grant another “state” when a “state” is removed.

It also adds the function to multiply the color of the cast graphic by an assigned color when the cast is in that “state”.

[b]- Animation of entering and exiting portraits for conversation events, and the function to change the order in which windows and portraits are rendered[/b]
You can now change the way the portrait is displayed at the beginning of a conversation or display the portrait over the message window.

Now you can also create a message window with the cast image over it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/aa9114873f8df4eca6e6cb151e98ca0c08822b4b.png[/img]

[b]- Added “Favorites” function to selector for choosing event panels[/b]
Added a function to the command selector that allows you to group frequently used event panels.

Simply check the stars next to each event panel to place it in the “Favorites” category.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/01ee357ab386d8ebc0c962d389ffb78b825c4421.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
For details on other update contents, please check the online manual or go to "[url=https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Update+log]Update Log[/url]" in the "Info & Tips" section of Bakin's Top Menu.

[b]We sincerely hope that the contents of this update will contribute to making your game more enjoyable!

We will continue to improve "RPG Developer Bakin".
Thank you for your continued support![/b]

notes.title: Decorate 3D backgrounds with 2D images! Update Ver. 1.10!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone!
We have updated to Ver. 1.10![/h3]

[b]We have finally implemented a decal function that allows 2D images to be projected onto maps and 3D models![/b]

In addition, the following features, which have been requested for some time, have been implemented.
[list]
[*] "Vertical Slider" that extends up and down, which can be set in Layout Tool
[*] Improved UI and added abilities for "State Definition"
[*] Added "Change Screen Switching Effect" panel
[*] Ability to change the selections displayed based on conditions
[/list]
Ver. 1.10 also includes various other additions and improvements, as well as bug fixes.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]---- Main Features of Ver. 1.10 ----[/h2]
[b]- A "decal" function has been added.[/b]

Added "Decal Stamps" to Resources to allow stamping of 2D images that specify a new "Decal shader" added to the Materials.
This allows you to decorate 3D backgrounds with 2D images.
This function can also be used as graphics for events, so it can be used as gimmicks for games.
Please see the video below for decals.

[previewyoutube=-aCsz1UkN4c;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]- "Vertical Sliders" that extend up and down can now be created with the Layout Tool.[/b]

"Slider Orientation" has been added to the properties of the Layout Tool > Slider panel, and the ability to select the orientation of slider expansion/contraction from "Up/Down" or " Left/Right" has been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/241cd815def05610f28abc769596baf2988c9bb4.png[/img]

[b]- Improved the editing UI of State Definition > ""State" Abilities".[/b]
Change to a UI where you can select and add abilities.
We will continue to improve the Database UI.

In addition, the following "state" abilities have been added:
Automatic damage besides HP, automatic recovery, and Change in Encounter Rate

[b]- A "Change Screen Switching Effect (Transition)" panel has been implemented to change the screen switching effect (transition) during the process of moving from map to battle and between maps in the middle of a game.[/b]

This will allow screen switching effects to be changed using events in "boss battles" and "scenes entering important maps".

[b]- The "Select from Selection and Check Results" panel now can specify a display condition switch for each selection.[/b]
This made it easier to create events such as "the selections change depending on which items they have". 

[hr][/hr]
For details on other update contents, please check the online manual or go to "Update Log" in the "Info & Tips" section of Bakin's Top Menu.

[b]We sincerely hope that the contents of this update will contribute to making your game more enjoyable!

We will continue to improve "RPG Developer Bakin".
Thank you for your continued support![/b]

notes.title: Major Update Ver. 1.9 is implemented!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone!
We have updated to Ver. 1.9![/h3]

Finally, mask animation has been implemented.
It is now possible to animate the area of the image to be masked by adding a mask layer to the sprite. This allows for a wider range of on-screen effects using 2D images, such as cutscenes for special moves, transitions during scene changes, and animations when the on-screen UI appears and disappears!

We have also added the ability to increase the number of battle commands as desired, and to narrow down the list of skills and items used in battles by "tags".
This allows you to implement "skill" and "spell" as separate commands, or to create many commands per skill, such as "fire" and "sleep," and assign them to the casts.

And! We have added free 2D assets with Chinese design to our Game Gallery!
It includes pixel-art style hero and monster casts, icon data for items, layout data and images that can be used for on-screen UI.

Ver. 1.9 also includes various other features and bug fixes.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]---- Main Features of Ver. 1.9 ----[/h2]
[b]- Added mask animation function.[/b]
The sprite tool can now specify a mask layer for sprites. Masked sprites can also be applied to layout parts, so they can be used for movements when appearing/disappearing for on-screen UI.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/ff9b04f5dbcdc54da6658907b2876a55b9d8ea48.png[/img]

[b]- Battle command addition function has been implemented.[/b]
You can now add as many battle commands as you like in the Database > Casts > Battles tab. At the same time, in the Layout Tool's battle-related screens, the list of skills and items to be used can be narrowed down using "tags" specified in the Database.
It will be possible to separate battle commands for different types of skills and items, such as "fire" and "heal", etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/76eeb161570fe1755b1f3386df55dd8ad74654a8.png[/img]

[b]- "Chinese Style 2D Assets", a 2D asset pack with Chinese design, has been added to the Game Gallery.[/b]
Pixel art style casts (7 heroes with various motions, 5 mobs with only some motions for use as NPCs, 16 monsters of 8 types for side-view battles), 100 icon images (45 types) that can be used for items, layout data and images that can be used for on-screen UI are compiled in an asset pack implemented in the Game Gallery.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/77c8775aac4f8627bfbe69cd91a86a2cb4a2b62d.png[/img]

 [hr][/hr]

For details on other update contents, please check the online manual or go to "[url=https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Update+log]Update Log[/url]" in the "Info & Tips" section of Bakin's Top Menu.

We sincerely hope that the contents of this update will contribute to making your game more enjoyable!
We will continue to improve "RPG Developer Bakin".
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Chinese language available! Layout mask function! Update Ver1.8!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone!
We have updated to Ver. 1.8.[/h3]

[b]To all Chinese language users, thank you for your patience![/b]
Bakin finally supports Chinese (Simplified/Traditional) from this version!
You can select your language in the Configuration settings.
We will continue to improve the quality of our translations, so please stay tuned!

Ver. 1.8 also includes various other new features and bug fixes. 
[hr][/hr]
[h2]--- Major Features of Ver. 1.8 ---[/h2]

[b]- Simplified (zh-Hans) and Traditional (zh-Hant) characters are now supported.[/b]
Please specify your language in the Top Menu > Configuration.
We will continue to improve the quality of our translations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/5e640e5024f5457e3df90362ebec878ec733127b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/6df0358c0d35e1bfc232c58f75dfba59ef575a73.png[/img]

[b]- Layout Tool now supports the mask function.[/b]
The layout parts of the container's child elements can be masked using images for masks that are set in the Container for Rendering.
Use this for displaying a mini map in a circular shape or a character image in a custom shape.
We will continue to expand support for mask functions, including sprites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/0b93034abd2eddf599d41ad68bc002b035f86b49.png[/img]

[b]- The UI for specifying the effects of skills and items in the Database has been changed.[/b]
We modified the method for adding effects to accommodate future functionality.
The 'add status type' user interface change will be implemented for each Database function in the future.

[b]- The number of available action buttons has been increased from three to ten.[/b]
We have added the action buttons by popular requests.
When combined with events, controller buttons, and keyboard keys, they can be used for various purposes.

[b]- A function has been implemented to vibrate the controller in response to screen shaking events.[/b]
When an event shakes the screen, the controller will vibrate accordingly.

[hr][/hr]

For information on other contents of the update, please check the [url=https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Update+log]online manual[/url] or the "Update Log" in the "Info and Tips" section of the Bakin top menu. We hope this update will make your game creation experience more enjoyable!

[b]We will continue to improve "RPG Developer Bakin".
Thank you all for your continued support!
[/b]

notes.title: [Update] Ver. 1.7.0.6
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone!
We have updated to Ver. 1.7.0.6![/b]
[hr][/hr]
[h3] --- New and Improved Features ---[/h3]
[b][Events] [/b]
- In the Command Selector when creating a battle event, the event panel related to layout, which is not available for battles, is now grayed out.

[b][Event Editor] [/b]
- When a user tries to edit a cast event in the Event Editor, a message confirming that it is a cast event that is being edited is now displayed.

- The background of the Item/Cast Base Event Edit dialog now has the same background color as the Common/Battle Events.


[h3] --- Bug Fixes ---[/h3]
[b][Events] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that caused an exception when making placement adjustments and confirming them in the "Make Monster Appear" panel.

- Fixed a bug that prevented assigning the number of the cast to be changed using a variable when the "Change Cast Status" panel was used during a battle.

- Fixed a bug in which sound effects continued to play even after the sprite was hidden when displayed as an image.

- Fixed a bug that could cause a movement to the final point (coordinates) of the destination for a moment when a move to the assigned coordinates was executed without specifying "Wait to Complete".


[b][Layout Tool] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that when the first entry in the menu is hidden, the cursor does not appear until the key for selection is pressed. The cursor has been improved to hit the visible entries in the menu.

- Fixed a bug that caused an exception when placing a submenu container for item sorting on the Equipment Item Selection screen.

- The Equipment Item Selection screen has been modified to allow the use of auto-sorting.

[b][Database] [/b]
- Fixed a bug in the Cast/Class Status Edit dialog that could cause an exception when attempting to sort entries by clicking on the header of the "Reference No." column.

[b][Map Editor] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that could cause irregular crashes on maps with cast events that use local lights for graphics.
In Resources > 3D/2D Stamps, there was a problem when using a graphic with local light linking turned on for subgraphics in a cast event.

- Fixed a bug in the Map Settings > Enemy Distribution tab where an exception would occur when opening the Battle Layout settings when the Max Appearing Number of the enemy was 0.

- Fixed a bug that prevented the Free Layout for Events from being displayed in the Battle Test.

[b][Play Execution Issues][/b]
- Fixed a bug in which "Consumption Status" was not consumed when using a skill "on maps".

- Fixed a bug that caused the Free Layout for Events being displayed to not reappear correctly when saving and loading after a battle.

[b][Others][/b]
- Fixed a bug in the Published Work Export function that prevented correct export when a file with no file extension was included in the export target (e.g., battlescript folder).

- Fixed a bug where the map background music/environmental sounds did not stop when resetting the test play or returning to the title with the layout feature.

- Fixed a bug that csproj was always regenerated and overwritten when editing C# scripts.

- The label "Old Style" on some elements in the event panel has been changed to "Deprecated".
These elements indicate that other alternatives are available because of previous updates.
[hr][/hr]
[b]We will continue to improve "RPG Developer Bakin".[/b]

notes.title: [Update] Ver. 1.7.0.5
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone!
We have updated to Ver. 1.7.0.5![/b]
[hr][/hr]
[h3] --- New and Improved Features ---[/h3]
[b][Resources] [/b]
- A "Selection History" function has been added to the "Local Files" tab of the Asset Picker.
You can select a previously selected file path in the File Path Name field.

- The context menu in the tree of Resources menu now supports "Change Import Source File".
Please use this function when the original file imported into Bakin is moved to another folder using Windows Explorer, or when the original file is copied to another folder and its contents are changed.


[b][Events] [/b]
- If only the "default" motion exists for the graphic assigned in the "Display Conversation" panel, the "default" is automatically selected for the motion field.
This is in response to a problem where an image does not appear immediately in the assigned field when a graphic is selected.


[b][Game Definition] [/b]
- In the Store tab of the Common Terms menu, the Purchase/Sold decision message can now be left blank to hide the message during the game.

[b][Others] [/b]
- Added text recommending driver updates for Intel-based GPUs to the readme.txt file generated when a game file is exported for publishing.
In some cases, when a game does not start, updating the GPU driver may be effective.

[h3] --- Bug Fixes ---[/h3]
[b][Battles] [/b]
- Fixed a bug in which the increase in maximum HP/MP due to equipment, state changes, and buff skills was not reflected internally correctly during battles.
The correction made in ver. 1.7.0.4 was not working properly and caused problems.

- Fixed a bug that caused monsters to change their orientation during battles with events, but immediately return to their original orientation.

- Fixed a bug that prevented screen clicks from progressing to the next scene at the end of the battle result screen.

[b][Play Execution Issues] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that caused an exception on the mini-map after loading and starting saved data outside of the map.

- Fixed a bug in which the player elevation was not restored correctly after loading and starting saved data outside of the map.


[b][Layout Tool] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused Purchase/Sold decision messages to appear on the back of the store layout.


[b][Events] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that caused an exception when clicking "Placement..." with "None" selected for Monster to be Appeared in the "Make Monster Appear" panel.

- In the "Check Contact Status" panel, when checking the number of events, an exception would occur if the variable contained a value less than or equal to 0.

- Fixed a bug that prevented the "Make Player/Event Walk to Specified Coordinates" panel from working properly when 0 seconds was assigned.

- Fixed a bug in the "Item Enhancement" panel in which local variables whose names began with a letter other than "L" were not referenced correctly.

- Fixed a bug that prevented removing C# scripts assigned to events.


[b][Published Work Export Issues] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that could cause a crash while switching maps in exported games.

- Fixed a bug that could cause a black square to be displayed momentarily for a conversational standing picture in exported games.


[b][Sprite Tool] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that allowed a copied layer to be pasted into the sound effect line as well. 

[hr][/hr]
[b]We will continue to improve "RPG Developer Bakin".[/b]

notes.title: [Update] Ver. 1.7.0.4
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone!

We have updated to Ver. 1.7.0.4![/b]
[hr][/hr]
[h3] --- New and Improved Features ---[/h3]
[b][Resources][/b]
- In Motions, motions in the Motion Set list can be rearranged by drag & drop.

- In Motions, when adding motions to a Motion Set, the "Internal Name" fields are now specified with the same text as the Name fields.

- The preview of the Asset Picker when selecting a material allows the user to see what the material will look like when the stamp or model to which it is assigned is selected and the material is assigned.

[b][Database] [/b]
- The "Obtain Item Parameter" panel is now available within the item's custom event.

- When entering a calculation formula in the Damage Formula dialog, the selected entry is now inserted at the cursor position.

[b][Others] [/b]
- Fixed the Color Picker so that the Enter key can be used to make decisions on the Color Picker.

Other minor UI improvements have been made.

[h3]--- Bug Fixes ---[/h3]
[b][Events] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that caused an exception when displaying the same type of layouts at the same time using the "Display Layout Screen" panel.

- Fixed a bug that caused both "Display Free Layout for Event" panels to be displayed even if they were not "Add and Display" when run simultaneously.

- Fixed a bug that could cause a processing error each time the "Display Conversation" panel is executed.

- Fixed a bug in which if a 3D model was used as a standing picture with the "Display Conversation" panel, it would not be displayed even if the same model was assigned as a standing picture after moving to a new location on the map.

- Fixed a bug in which if the "Make Player/Event Walk to Specified Coordinates" panel was being executed and the execution was interrupted by a sheet change, etc., the target would be transported to the final coordinates.

- In the "Add/Remove Party Member" panel, if "Carry Over Status from Previous Participation" is on and the cast member is in the reserve group, the cast member will be returned to the party from the reserve group.

- Fixed a bug that caused walking to be interrupted if the player's graphics were changed while the player was walking by an event.

- Fixed a bug where if events were made invisible over time, they could not be brought back from being invisible.

- Fixed a bug where the "Recover/Reduce HP or MP" panel was not being reflected correctly in the internal values when used during battles.

- Fixed a bug in which the grid widths of Chang Elements were not saved when the Event Editor Sheet was executed.

- Fixed a bug where the size of the graphic assignments field for events in the Event Editor was not being saved.

- Fixed a bug in which a button to add a "Parallel Sheet" was sometimes displayed in the Event Editor for Common Events/Battle Events.

[b][Battles][/b]
- Fixed a bug where, during battles, the increase in maximum HP/MP due to equipment, state changes, and skills that change equipment, states, or ability values would not be reflected internally correctly.

- Fixed a bug in which the luminous effect at the feet would not disappear when the skill user was removed from the party using a common event called from a skill during battle.

- Fixed a bug that caused an exception when removing both the skill user and target from the party using a common event called from a skill during battle.

[b][Camera Tool] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that caused the camera to stop tracking after the camera animation ended when a cast-based event was specified as the camera's gazing point.

- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused screen distortion without correct interpolation when interpolating between camera frames.

[b][Play Execution Issues] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that prevented the physics-related processing of cast members in the Party Train at the map destination from being initialized.

[b][Map Editor] [/b]
- Fixed a bug where double-clicking on a grouped event/object would always open the Event Editor of the first element in the group.

- Fixed a bug that prevented collisions from being generated for sprite-based object stamps.

- In the starting point settings (angle, scale, etc.), fields that are originally unchangeable are now completely unchangeable.

[b][Game Settings] [/b]
- Fixed a bug in which grid column positions were not being saved on the Rules and Operations page.

[b][Others] [/b]
- Fixed a problem in the Published Work Export function where the "Export" button is clickable during the export process.

- Fixed a bug in the Event Template "All Purpose Button Treasure Chest - Get an Item" where the SE was not assigned correctly.
[hr][/hr]
[b]We will continue to improve "RPG Developer Bakin".[/b]

notes.title: Toon Shader, Blend Shapes & Consumption Statuses! Update Ver. 1.7!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! 
We have updated to Ver. 1.7! [/b]

[h3]This time, a toon shader, blend shapes, and the ability to add consumption statuses! [/h3]
[previewyoutube=j5wsTZcMoaU;full][/previewyoutube]
The [b]toon shader[/b] can be applied to materials in the FBX model and parameters can be set to give the object a cartoon style appearance. It is now possible to adjust various parameters as well as specify outlines.

[b]Blend shapes (morphing)[/b] can be created by combining keys in a model to create "clips," which can then be called from events. This function is mainly utilized to animate the facial expressions of 3D models. Conversation event-related functions have also been enhanced, making it easier to use 3D models as standing pictures for conversations.

Moreover, the [b]consumption statuses[/b], like "HP", can now be freely created to have a maximum value and a current value. For example, "Create different statuses from MP to use for "magic" and "skills," "Set stamina consumption for battle commands for each character," and so on. You can use them in various ways, depending on your ingenuity.　 

[b]This is the last major update for 2023 with various other added features. [/b]

[b]Please check out the details of the update. [/b]
[hr][/hr]
[h2] --- New and Improved Features --- [/h2]
[h3][Toon Shader & Outlines] [/h3]
- Added "toon shader" and "outline settings" to the Resources>Materials properties. 
You can assign a "toon shader" to a material in an FBX model and set each map and parameter to create a cartoon style appearance. 
We have also added new options to specify the presence of outlines, color, and thickness. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/3fc5ec8a97481a7865c6bd55e12b9a2e5f72324b.png[/img]

　[b]For an explanation of toon shader properties, please see the manual. [/b]
　　[url=https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Shaders] RPG Developer Bakin Wiki "Shaders"[/url]
　
　[u][b](!)Bakin supports FBX format only. [/b][/u]
　[u][b]For information on how to convert from VRM format to FBX format and import into Bakin, please refer to this page. [/b][/u] 
　　[url=https://rpgbakin.com/pukiwiki_en/?Convert+VRM+to+FBX+and+Import+to+Bakin] RPG Developer Bakin Wiki "Convert VRM to FBX and Import to Bakin"[/url]

　The implementation of the ability to directly read VRM format files is currently under consideration. 

[h3][Blend Shapes][/h3]
[b]- The following features regarding blend shapes have been added. [/b]
　It can be called from an event by combining keys contained in the model.
　This can be used to add facial expressions to 3D models. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/a9b710dfd38ceeefe39c5758eeeb8b4a84ac62ed.png[/img]

　[b]- A "Blend Shapes" menu entry has been added to Resources.  [/b]

　[b]- Added "Apply Blend Shapes to Player/This Event" panel to the "Player" and "Events" in the Event Categories. [/b]
 
　[b]You can apply it in the following steps. [/b]
[olist]
　[*] Create a clip with a combination of keys in Resources > Blend Shapes. 
　[*] [u]Assign blend shapes to be applied to the stamp in the Blend Shape Settings field of the 3D Stamp.[/u]
　[*] Assign a clip to play in the Event Panel. 
[/olist]
　　　If you need to reset a key when creating a clip, use the reset button above the Blend Shape Preview. 

[h3][Conversation Scenes] [/h3]
[b]　- Creating a camera for conversation scenes & specifying rendering settings and the ability to select the camera to be used for the conversation scene. [/b]
　This makes it easier to utilize the 3D models as standing pictures for conversation scenes.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/1b647745fdf29940560af06c0c2157bf8bf39638.png[/img]
[b]　-- A "Conversation Scenes" folder has been added to the Camera Tool.[/b] 
　　　Select this folder and press the Add button at the top of the tree to add a camera.  
[expand type=details]There are buttons above the camera preview to place the conversational characters to the left and right. Settings particular to the camera for conversation scenes include "Cast Spacing" and "Cast Angle". Preset data for conversation scenes are included in the "Preset Data (for camera)" and "Rendering Settings" sections. [/expand]

[b]　-- A "Switch Conversation Scene Camera" panel has been added to the Cameras in the Event Categories. [/b]
　　　Specify a camera for the conversation scene in the Camera Tool and assign that camera with this panel. 

[b]　-- Assigning blend shapes in the "Display Conversation" event panel is now supported. [/b]
　　　You can assign a Clip created in Resources > Blend Shapes.

　　　[b][u]If the following Clips are created in the Blend Shapes, they will be used for blinking and lip-synching in conversational scenes.[/u][/b] 
　　　The speed of the blinking and lip-synching can be adjusted in the Input Support Forms.  
[list]
　　[*] Clip Name "blink": Key with eyes closed. 
　　[*] Clip Name "talk": Key with mouth opened.
[/list]
 　　　Note that if a 2D stamp is selected for the graphic of the cast to be displayed, it will be rendered in 3D if the "Billboard" checkbox is checked. 

[h3] [Consumption Statuses][/h3]

[b]- A function to add "Consumption Statuses" has been implemented. [/b]
　Added the ability to specify statuses with a maximum/current value, such as HP and MP. 
　[u]This feature will be further improved in the future to make it easier to use for items, etc. [/u]

[b]　[Database] [/b]
[b]　- The "Casts" and "Classes" Status dialog can now specify "Consumption Statuses" such as HP and MP. Damage and recovery colors can also be set.  [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/1b647745fdf29940560af06c0c2157bf8bf39638.png[/img]

 　 - The "Damage Formula" and "Battle AI Conditions" of the cast can now use consumption type statuses. 

　- Added to the Basic tab of Skills, the consumption status other than HP/MP as Consumption Elements by the use of the skill. 

[b]　 [Events] [/b]
　 - The following event panels have been modified so that the consumption status can be selected. 
[list]
　　[*] Screen Effects: "Specify Game Over"
　　[*] Statuses: "Obtain Cast Status", "Change Cast Status"
　　[*] Battles: " Recover/Reduce Battle Cast's HP/MP", "Obtain Battle Information"  
[/list]
　- The following event commands have been modified so that all consumption statuses are eligible for recovery. 
[list]
　　[*] Statuses: "Fully Recover Party"
　　[*] Conditional Judgment: " Display Inn and Check Results"  
[/list]
[b] 　 [Layout Tool] [/b]
　- Added special formats for displaying consumption status.


[h3][Additional Functions] [/h3]

[b][Map Editor] [/b]
[b]- Added the ability to assign a color to symbol icons representing events without graphics. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509419/179ca080e396d24532c9278b95db8d6e981efb8c.png[/img]
　　This function is used to change the color of map-to-map movement events and key events to make them easier to distinguish on the Map Editor. 
Right-click on the symbol with an "E" in the Map Editor and select "Event Symbol Color" in the context menu. 

- When raising/lowering terrain, only the "currently selected objects/events" are now moved up or down in Y position according to the terrain. 
[expand type=details] Previously, when only terrain was selected for raising/lowering, objects on top of the terrain would move up and down with the terrain, even if they were not selected.
Only the currently selected objects will move together with the terrain. [/expand]


- In the Placed List palette, the deletion process of events involving movement, such as doors and stairs, has been sped up.　 

[b][Events] [/b]
[b]- Cast level can be changed in the "Change Cast Status" panel.  [/b]

- Added a function to the "Advanced Variable Box Operation" panel to retrieve the current number of people in the reserve slots.  

[b][Battles] [/b]
- Improved the battle message layout to skip the time for displaying battle messages if the content of the layout is empty. 

[b][Plug-ins] [/b]
- Added "FixedUpdate" to C# script with always 60 calls per second. 
  
[b][Resources] [/b]
- Zooming process by wheel and panning behavior by middle drag in model preview have been improved.  

- Material preview has been improved so that a stamp using that material can also be selected as a model for preview. 

[b][Others] [/b]
- Improved color picker history recording method.  


[h2] --- Bug Fixes --- [/h2]
[b][Play Execution Issues] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that could cause local lights on the moving map to affect the background during battles.

- Fixed a bug that could cause an exception if a map move were performed during the transparency/untransparency of a stamp's subgraphic. 

- Fixed a bug that caused the game to start from very high coordinates when starting the game outside the map.

[b][Battles] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that caused member placement to be corrupted when adding or deleting members during a battle. 

- Fixed a bug that caused attack range calculations to be performed at the position before the move even on the next turn when a monster automatically moved to the front during battle. 

- Fixed a bug in the damage display process in map battles that caused the display coordinates to move to the map origin when the damage target was discarded. 

- Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented the SkyBox from being rendered at certain times during battles. 

[b][Events] [/b]
[strike]- Fixed a bug in which icon and standing picture changes made with "Change Cast Graphic" were not reflected during battle. [/strike]

- Fixed a bug in applying "Advanced Settings" in the "Specify Game Over" panel that caused the game to become inoperable at game over if the "Common Events to be executed after movement" were not assigned. 

- Fixed a bug in which when a party member was removed using an event when the reserve slot was full, the member in question could not enter the reserve and data was lost. 

- In the "Display Inn and Check Results" panel, the "Recover from KO" checkbox specification was not being saved correctly. 

- Fixed a bug in the "Add/Remove Party Member" panel in which the function to assign a variable to a departing member did not work.
 
- Fixed a bug in the "Recover/Reduce Battle Cast's HP/MP" panel that caused an exception if a value less than or equal to 0 was assigned using a variable.

[b][Layout Tool] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that caused the player to freeze when "invalid menu entry" was assigned to the submenu container as the "menu entry to move to when the cursor is pressed".

- Fixed a bug in which the "Wait to Close" function, a property of the Free Layout for Event, did not work correctly only for the "When Player Makes Contact with Event" trigger of the event start condition.

- Improved behavior when the number of columns and rows in the menu container is set to 2 or more in the Replace Members layout. 

[b][Map Editor] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that prevented folder information in the Placed List from being readable. 

- Fixed a bug that prevented the lock icon from operating when copying and pasting groups in the Placed List. 

[b][Common Event Editor/Common Event Palette] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that the view ON/OFF check was not being saved for folders of common events. 

- Fixed a bug that caused folder information (view ON/OFF, etc.) to be initialized when exiting the Common Event Editor with Cancel.

- Fixed a bug that caused folder information to be lost when a folder in the Common Event List was selected, copied, and pasted. 

[b][Resources] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that prevented exporting resources added from exrbr files. 

- Fixed a bug that material information in the def file could not be read if a material name contained a single-byte space. 

- Fixed a bug that caused an exception when selecting Cancel in the overwrite confirmation dialog when selecting a file with the same name as an existing texture when assigning a texture for a material. 

- Fixed a bug that could cause parameters to be reflected in the wrong subgraphic only in preview when changing subgraphic offsets, etc.

[b][Camera Tool] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that prevented the Camera Tool from working properly when cast-based events were used as gazing points. 

[b][Game Definition] [/b]
- If there are no layout parts in the layout of the startup logo screen in Layout Tool, the logo display will be skipped. 
However, fixed a bug that caused title skip to be ignored if title skip was further enabled in that state.

[hr][/hr]
[b]How do you like it? [/b]

[b]It is our sincere hope that the contents of this update will contribute to making your game more enjoyable!  [/b]

We will continue to improve "RPG Developer Bakin".
[b]Thank you all for your continued support!  [/b]
